claim_legs.durability: Git-bound original evidence, prospective source pins, full new case streams, losslessly encoded raw outputs and saved-only auditor survive independently of ignored logs.
claim_legs.falsification: Cross-stage mismatches remain individually admissible where intended but must reject as pairs; complete saved-result omission, corruption and hidden-launch controls reject.
claim_legs.rederivation: Authenticate the complete selected Git file domain and each original source epoch; rederive all stage cases with original pure independent oracles, then independently check the matched byte/identity bindings.

compiler_template: Reuse original saved compilation fields unchanged. Only private source paths are substituted in the fixed argv. Synthetic source identities and in-memory header bytes do not prove an actual compilation.
domain: Complete saved layout, preparation, capture and retained domains; new matched records for both C modes, alternate observer and every retained scope across four lexical roots. Independently valid changed references, other-mode preparation, failed preparation and other-mode envelopes must not join.
legacy: All selected source and saved bytes remain exact. Original pins and first failures retain their own source epoch; corrected pins do not replace first pins. Pure source/data functions only, never original mains.
limits: Inactive private data compatibility only. Native authentication, current filesystem custody, real compilation/ownership transport, collector outcomes, policy records, public projection integration, combined lifetimes and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain separately owned. No original process or archive replay.
read_only_external_dependency: System Perl identity is resolved from /usr/bin/perl; the exact already-cleaned same-volume misplaced book root is checked read-only. No off-volume project cache or allocation.
